iti93:2.1: (Tik. V.) Tayo-me bhikkhave aggī. Katame tayo? Rāgaggi, dosaggi, mohaggi. Ime kho bhikkhave tayo aggīti. Rāgaggi dahati macce ratte kāmesu mucchite | dosaggi
iti93:4.1: mohaggi pana sammūḷhe ariyadhamme akovide | ete aggī ajānantā sakkāyābhiratā pajā ||
iti93:5.1: Te vaḍḍhayanti nirayaṃ tiracchānañca yoniyo | asuraṃ pettivisayañca amuttā mārabandhanā ||
iti93:6.1: Ye ca rattiṃ divā yuttā sammāsambuddhasāsane | te nibbāpenti rāgaggiṃ niccaṃ asubhasaññino ||
iti93:7.1: dosaggiṃ pana mettāya nibbāpenti naruttamā | mohaggiṃ pana paññāya yāyaṃ nibbedhagāminī ||
iti93:8.1: Te nibbāpetvā nipakā rattindivam-atanditā | asesaṃ parinibbanti asesaṃ dukkham-accaguṃ ||
iti93:9.1: Ariyaddasā vedaguno sammad-aññāya paṇḍitā | jātikkhayam-abhiññāya nāgacchanti punabbhavan-ti ||4||
